sloka: अमात्या बल मुख्याः च मुख्या ये निगमस्य च ।राघवस्य अभिषेक अर्थे प्रीयमाणाः तु सम्गताः ॥२-१५-२॥
transliteration: amātyā bala mukhyāḥ ca mukhyā ye nigamasya ca ।rāghavasya abhiṣeka arthe prīyamāṇāḥ tu samgatāḥ ॥2-15-2॥

translations.english: For the consecration of the scion of the Raghu race (Rama), ministers, army chiefs and chiefs of merchants' associations assembled, brimming with joy.
